subject: trial
notes: Phase 1: outside C05's scope even though it is completed and FDA-regulated.

trial.brief_title: Determining How Quickly Progesterone Slows LH Pulse Frequency

identificationModule.briefTitle: Determining How Quickly Progesterone Slows LH Pulse Frequency

outcomes.description: The primary endpoint is the change in the number of LH pulses (over 10 hours) attributable to progesterone.
outcomes.time_frame: 10 hours before and after administration of micronized progesterone and placebo

outcomes.description: A secondary endpoint is the change in mean LH concentration (over 10 hours) attributable to progesterone.
outcomes.time_frame: 10 hours before and after administration of micronized progesterone and placebo

outcomes.description: A secondary endpoint is the change in LH pulse mass (a correlate of LH pulse amplitude) attributable to progesterone.
outcomes.time_frame: 10 hours before and after administration of micronized progesterone and placebo

outcomes.description: A secondary endpoint is the change in mean FSH concentration (over 10 hours) attributable to progesterone.
outcomes.time_frame: 10 hours before and after administration of micronized progesterone and placebo
